# SPECIAL STATUSES (international_organization_special_statuses/):
#
#   cci_superba:
#     - Full voting rights, can propose resolutions
#     - Parliament power: high
#     - Only City of Genoa at start
#
#   cci_ghazaria:
#     - Full voting rights, can propose resolutions
#     - Enables special trade buildings in assigned sea region
#     - Gazaria (Black Sea) at start; Western Office (Atlantic) unlockable via law
#     - Extraterritorial — no land, only buildings
#
#   cci_state_bank:
#     - Full voting rights, can propose resolutions
#     - Can absorb (annex) Maone, turning them into "client" subjects
#     - Created via parliament resolution when debt >= 5000 or bankrupt
#     - Player can switch to play as the Bank
#
#   cci_maona:
#     - Junior voting rights in parliament
#     - Created via "Organize Expedition" parliament resolution
#     - Has charter timer (20-50 years)
#     - On charter expiry, leader gets event:
#         1. Buy back (costs gold)
#         2. Extend charter (- prestige, + estate influence, - estate loyalty)
#         3. Sell to Bank (Bank gains Maona as client subject, Bank rises)
#     - Transfers trade influence to Genoa, no monthly tax
#     - Funded by estate wealth pool (one-time lump sum to Genoa)

cci_superba = {
	priority = 10
    max_countries = 1
    leader = yes

	modifier = {
	}

	can_bestow_trigger = {
		this = c:GEN
		# is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
	}
	
	auto_bestowal_trigger = {
	}
	
	auto_rescind_trigger = {
	}
		
	on_bestowed_effect = {
	}
	
	on_rescinded_effect = {
	}
	
	map_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_LEADER_COLOR
}

cci_ghazaria = {
    priority = 5
    
    modifier = {
    }
    
    can_bestow_trigger = {
        this = c:GAZ
    }
    
    auto_bestowal_trigger = {
	}
	
	auto_rescind_trigger = {
	}
		
	on_bestowed_effect = {
	}
	
	on_rescinded_effect = {
	}
    
    map_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_TIER2_COLOR
}

cci_state_bank = {
    priority = 4
    
    modifier = {
    }
    
    can_bestow_trigger = {
        has_reform = government_reform:banking_country
    }
    
    auto_bestowal_trigger = {
	}
	
	auto_rescind_trigger = {
	}
		
	on_bestowed_effect = {
	}
	
	on_rescinded_effect = {
	}
    
    map_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_TIER2_COLOR
}

cci_maona = {
    priority = 3
    
    modifier = {
    }
    
    can_bestow_trigger = {
        # todo has_reform = government_reform:maona
        is_subject = yes
		is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
    }
    
    auto_bestowal_trigger = {
	}
	
	auto_rescind_trigger = {
	}
		
	on_bestowed_effect = {
	}
	
	on_rescinded_effect = {
	}
    
    map_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_TIER3_COLOR
}
